review: 103.1c-1: Power Play is a conspiracy that exists only in Conspiracy Draft (rule 905, a chapter 9 casual variant) and the rule governs starting-player determination, which the README puts out of scope; reclassified 103.1c as out_of_scope in triage and dropped the scenario.

scenarios.title: A card allowing it begins the game on the battlefield

setup.notes: Pre-game, after mulligans and before turn 1. The seven cards in A's hand are A's opening hand; A takes the opening-hand action.

decisions: A chooses to begin the game with Leyline of Sanctity on the battlefield.

variants.label: in_opening_hand
variants.expected: Leyline of Sanctity moves from A's hand to the battlefield before turn 1; A's hand has six Plains and A has hexproof.

variants.label: on_top_of_library
variants.delta: Leyline of Sanctity is the top card of A's library and the opening hand is seven Plains.
variants.expected: Leyline of Sanctity stays in A's library; nothing is put onto the battlefield before turn 1 and A does not have hexproof.

scenarios.title: The starting player skips the draw step of their first turn

setup.notes: Turn 1 of a two-player game; A is the starting player and the draw step is about to begin.

decisions: Both players pass in the draw step with no responses.

variants.label: starting_player_first_turn
variants.expected: A draws no card: A's hand stays at Mountain and A's library keeps Plains and Island.

variants.label: opponent_first_turn
variants.delta: It is B's first turn (turn 2) and B is the active player.
variants.expected: B draws Plains: B's hand is Mountain and Plains, B's library is Island.

variants.label: starting_player_second_turn
variants.delta: It is A's second turn (turn 3) instead of turn 1.
variants.expected: A draws Plains: A's hand is Mountain and Plains, A's library is Island.
